stylePrefix: HD pixel art, 16-bit/32-bit modern indie visual novel aesthetic, crisp nearest-neighbor pixels, warm tropical Philippine sunlight and twilight color palette, rich environmental detail, no anti-aliasing blur, no text, no watermark

backgrounds.prompt: Warm Filipino provincial ancestral/concrete-and-wood house interior and porch at golden morning, capiz shell windows, electric fan, calendar on wall, rice fields and coconut palms visible outside, steaming pandesal on table

Lively Philippine barangay street in sunny morning, colorful tricycles parked, basketball court hoop in distance, tangled electrical wires, tropical bougainvillea over concrete fences, small sari-sari store awning

First-person perspective inside a classic Philippine jeepney, stainless steel handrails, red and yellow upholstered benches, small hanging rosaries and 'Barya lang po sa umaga' sign, warm afternoon sunlight streaming through open windows

Philippine public high school and state university concrete gate arch at sunrise, Philippine flag waving proudly on tall flagpole, acacia trees lining the walkway, guard house, students walking in white and navy uniforms

Classic Philippine classroom interior, green chalkboard with chalk dust, wooden armchairs in rows, spinning ceiling fans, jalousie glass windows letting in warm afternoon sun, framed Jose Rizal portrait above blackboard

Bustling Philippine school canteen at lunch recess, glass display counter with turon, banana cue, pansit, and stainless steel trays, long wooden benches, hanging menu board with affordable student prices
Philippine university computer laboratory with rows of desktop monitors glowing softly with code and spreadsheets, humming split-type aircon, whiteboard with flowchart diagrams, cool indoor lighting
Quiet Philippine university library in late afternoon, tall wooden bookshelves packed with textbooks and bound theses, study tables with yellow pad papers, highlighters, and warm desk lamps
Neighborhood Philippine sari-sari store at dusk, metal security grille window hung with colorful shampoo sachets, snack packs, canned goods, warm yellow incandescent bulb glowing over wooden counter

Cozy roadside Philippine carinderia eatery, steaming stainless kaldero pots of adobo and sinigang behind glass case, plastic monoblock chairs, electric fan, checkered oilcloth tables, warm evening glow
Small Metro Manila student boarding house room at night, double-deck bed, small desk stacked with notebooks and instant noodle cups, clip-on desk fan, window overlooking glowing city apartment roofs
University Belt Manila street at golden sunset rush hour, elevated LRT train track above, colorful jeepneys with glowing headlights, photocopier and printing stalls, bustling sidewalks with students
Dramatic typhoon monsoon rain over flooded Manila street at dusk, ankle-deep water reflecting warm streetlight ripples, slanting pixel rain streaks, colorful umbrellas, stranded jeepney lights

Festive Philippine barangay fiesta night plaza, overhead crisscrossing colorful paper banderitas flags, glowing string bulbs, food stalls with sizzling barbecue smoke, church facade illuminated in background
Magical Philippine December night street, glowing star-shaped capiz parol lanterns hanging from every porch, warm bibingka and puto bumbong stall emitting fragrant steam, twinkling lights
Triumphant Philippine university graduation auditorium stage, deep royal blue velvet curtains, golden sunlight rays, floral garlands and sampaguita leis, proud podium and rows of cheering families
